---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new component, output type, or capability
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: LaurenceA4L
---

**Target platform / device family**
e.g. Agilex5, Cyclone V, Arria 10 — or "general" if not device-specific.

**What's currently missing or broken**
Describe what sopc2dts doesn't do today that you need.

**What you'd expect it to do**
Describe the desired behaviour. If relevant, show an example of the DTS output you'd expect.

**Workaround (if any)**
What you're doing now to work around the limitation.

**Additional context**
Links to relevant kernel DTS bindings, Intel documentation, or example sopcinfo files are very helpful.
